Together with Romain Chilly—a lawyer specializing in cryptocurrencies and cybercrime—we break down the methods used by these new-age criminals and explore how to protect yourself against them.

4.name: THIERRY LHERMITTE: REUNITING WITH MIMI-SIKU FROM *AN INDIAN IN THE CITY*—PLUS SOME WILD ANECDOTES
4.overview: Thanks to Thierry Lhermitte for appearing on *Legend*. From *Les Bronzés* and *Le Dîner de cons* to *An Indian in the City*, Thierry Lhermitte has left an indelible mark on French cinema with films that have become cult classics. For *Legend*, the actor looked back on his early days, shared some of the wildest anecdotes from his time with *Le Splendid*, and recounted the most memorable stories from his career.

4.name: HER FUTURE HUSBAND TRIES TO KILL HER TO COLLECT €8 MILLION IN LIFE INSURANCE
4.overview: Thank you to Julie for coming to share her story on *Legend Story*. Believing she had met the perfect man, Julie survived an attempted murder after being manipulated into signing a life insurance policy worth €8 million. The man—dubbed the "seducer of Essonne"—killed four women between 2006 and 2010, always using the same *modus operandi*: he would identify his targets, seduce them, get them to sign life insurance policies, and then murder them to collect the payout.

4.name: PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT SUPERSTAR: A MASTERCLASS WITH NATACHA CALESTRÉMÉ
4.overview: Thank you to Natacha Calestrémé for visiting Legend. Natacha Calestrémé—a journalist and a leading figure in the field of personal development—joined us at Legend to share her best advice for greater daily fulfillment. From managing stress and navigating toxic relationships to addressing intergenerational issues, she answered all our questions and provided practical tools to help us better understand ourselves and lead happier lives.

4.name: ETIQUETTE EXPERT: ETIQUETTE MISTAKES YOU’RE MAKING WITHOUT EVEN REALIZING IT!
4.overview: Thanks to Jérémy Côme for joining us on *Legend*. From table manners and conversation topics to common blunders—this expert in French etiquette reminds us of the proper ways to behave and corrects all those little mistakes we make in our daily lives without even noticing!

4.name: SHE FOUND HERSELF AT THE HEART OF MARSEILLE’S LARGEST DRUG NETWORK: THE FRENCH CONNECTION
4.overview: At 78, Arlette recounts her extraordinary story. As the wife of a chemist for the French Connection—the notorious Marseille-based criminal network specializing in drug trafficking—she looks back on her time at the heart of the organization, her life in prison, and all the secrets surrounding the group.

4.name: THE WATER YOU DRINK IS DANGEROUS! EVERYTHING YOU DIDN’T KNOW ABOUT WATER!
4.overview: Thanks to hydrologist Emma Haziza for appearing on *Legend*. She joined the show to break down the water cycle, the impact of the water we drink on our health, the daily water consumption habits of the French, and the current state of our water resources.

4.name: INHERITANCES, STOLEN HOMES, HIDDEN WILLS: THE PITFALLS THAT CAN RUIN YOU!
4.overview: Thanks to Antoine Charbonneau for appearing on Legend! As a co-founder of Basalt, he explains how to better manage your money, invest in life insurance, and avoid costly mistakes. We also thank notary Antoine Cellard, who shared some of the wildest stories from his career—from families torn apart over an inheritance to mysterious, wax-sealed wills…

4.name: CHRISTOPHE HONDELATTE TELLS US ABOUT THE CRIMINAL CASES THAT SHOCKED HIM THE MOST!
4.overview: Thanks to Christophe Hondelatte for appearing on Legend. Christophe Hondelatte, a French journalist and presenter, joined us on Legend to share some of the wildest criminal cases that have left a lasting impression on him. Murders, disappearances, psychopaths—he delves into the details of these stories, which are as chilling as they are incredible!

4.name: DURING A PARTY, THEY KILL HIS BROTHER AND BURY HIS BODY AT THE BACK OF THE GARDEN
4.overview: Thank you to Myriam for coming to share her story on *Legend Story*. Ismaël traveled to Alsace to celebrate a birthday, but he would never return alive. Worried after hearing nothing from him, his sister Myriam tried to reach him, but to no avail. Six years later, his body was discovered buried in a garden. Refusing to accept the theory that it was an accident, Myriam has since been conducting her own investigation to understand the circumstances of his death and uncover the truth.

4.name: MEDIUM AND FUNERAL DIRECTOR: SHE SPEAKS TO THE DEAD SHE CARES FOR—AND REVEALS THEIR DARKEST SECRETS
4.overview: Thanks to Christelle Dubois for appearing on Legend. Since the age of 8, Christelle has been able to see, hear, and communicate with the dead. As a medium who also works in the funeral industry, she has encountered experiences and received confidences that are, to say the least, unsettling. From murders and sexual abuse to family secrets—she shares with Legend the wildest anecdotes and the most unexpected revelations entrusted to her by the deceased.

4.name: THIS HACKER TRACKS DOWN AND EXPOSES THE WORST SCAMMERS ON THE WEB! SEXUAL BLACKMAIL, CELEBRITIES BEING SWINDLED...
4.overview: Thanks to Marwan for appearing on *Legend*. A former scammer himself, he created "Findmyscammer" to help victims of fraud! From athletes being entrapped and fake singers to sexual blackmail—he returns to *Legend* for a second time to share the wildest cases he’s ever had to handle! Thanks also to Frédéric and Jérémy for taking part in the show.

4.name: A NIGHT WITH THE PROSTITUTES OF THE BOIS DE BOULOGNE! (SEX, VIOLENCE, PIMPS, CLIENTS…)
4.overview: Thanks to Yannis, Stella, Fernanda, Lolita, and Tilly for sharing their stories with Legend Story. We had been wanting to do this for a long time: spend an immersive night with the prostitutes in the Bois de Boulogne, in Paris. We wanted to understand their daily lives—how they handle seeing multiple clients each evening, how they work through various weather conditions, whether pimps are involved, and how much money they earn from sex work. Please note: this report does not claim to represent every aspect of prostitution in France; it simply gives a voice to the women we met.

4.name: TRANSGENDER WOMAN: SHE REGRETS HER TRANSITION AND HAS BEEN LIVING A NIGHTMARE SINCE HER SEX CHANGE
4.overview: Thank you to Karlee for appearing on Legend. Karlee underwent a gender transition and is now suffering the severe consequences. Speaking to LEGEND, she shares her story and denounces a system that, in her view, failed to adequately inform her of the risks—providing what she considers insufficient psychiatric support for such a significant, life-altering decision. Today, she wishes to detransition, but explains that it is now impossible for her to return to her original body.

overview:
Four LEGEND episodes every week.

Whether famous or not, LEGEND gives a voice to anyone with an extraordinary life story to share.

Tune in each week for four new podcast interviews. Catch our interviews and reports every Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday at 11 a.m., as well as our LEGEND STORY format at the same time on Tuesdays.
